note: Add to Cal ships two Field API formatters (addtocal_view, addtocal_grouped_view) for date field types (date, datestamp, datetime, daterange, daterange_timezone, date_recur, smartdate) that render an Add to Calendar button (Google/Yahoo/Outlook.com/Office.com/ics via spatie/calendar-links). Formatter settings: event_title, location, description (token-aware), separator (range fields), past_events (bool). No config UI (configure=null); configured per field on Manage display (entity_view_display). It also defines hook_addtocal_links_alter(), theme hook addtocal_links, and an addtocal-url token type. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real entity_view_display components for datetime fields on the Article bundle.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal addtocal (Add to Cal) module, which field formatters does it provide and which date field types can they be used on?
evals.expected_output: Formatters addtocal_view (Add to Cal) and addtocal_grouped_view (grouped button), usable on date, datestamp, datetime, daterange, daterange_timezone, date_recur and smartdate fields.

evals.prompt: What calendar targets does the Add to Cal button link to, and which PHP library generates those links?
evals.expected_output: It builds links for Google, Yahoo, Outlook.com (web_outlook), Office.com (web_office) and a downloadable iCal/.ics file, using the spatie/calendar-links library.

evals.prompt: Which formatter settings does the Add to Cal (addtocal_view) formatter expose to control the generated calendar event, and how do you configure them (is there an admin settings page)?
evals.expected_output: There is no admin settings page (configure=null); configure it per field on Manage display. Settings: event_title, location, description (token-aware), separator (for range fields) and past_events (whether to show the widget for past events).

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has a datetime field (field_atc_known) whose display uses the Add to Cal formatter with a custom event title configured. Inspect the live display configuration and report the configured event title.
evals.expected_output: The event_title setting is 'ATC Probe Event' on the addtocal_view component for field_atc_known in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has two datetime fields, field_atc_on and field_atc_off, both displayed with the Add to Cal formatter. Exactly one of them is configured to still show the Add to Calendar widget for events in the past. Inspect the live display configuration and state which field that is.
evals.expected_output: field_atc_on has past_events = TRUE on its addtocal_view component, whereas field_atc_off has past_events = FALSE (core.entity_view_display.node.article.default).

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has a datetime field field_atc_task. Using the addtocal module, configure the default display so this field renders as an Add to Calendar button (the addtocal_view formatter). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_atc_task component type is set to addtocal_view (e.g. setComponent with type addtocal_view, or pick 'Add to Cal' on Manage display).

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has a datetime field field_atc_title. Configure its default display to use the Add to Cal (addtocal_view) formatter and set the calendar event title to exactly 'ATC Launch'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The field_atc_title component uses addtocal_view with settings.event_title === 'ATC Launch' in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.
